summary: This is an 8-K filed by Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund S to report a routine unregistered sale of equity securities. On April 17, 2026, the company issued and sold 377,517 common shares at $24.73 per share for aggregate proceeds of ~$9.3 million under subscription agreements with accredited investors, relying on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D exemptions. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special-situation event occurred; the filing also includes standard portfolio updates under Item 7.01. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural changes warranting a special-situations classification.
